notes: A Backstage backend plugin (acme-actions: HTTP API, approval gate, SQLite run and event tables), a catalog entity provider reading each origin's main, one custom scaffolder action, shared git helpers, and a dependency-free Node CLI in org/bin. No runtime data appears in the lines map: run records live in backstage/.acme-data/ and the log in backstage/.acme-backend.log, neither counted by score.py, so nothing was struck. Every counted file is code or configuration a person would keep. Observations outside the probes: the success check compares origin main with the content the scaffolder action reported (run.report), which the action can only produce after claiming an approved run whose template and parameters match, rather than re-rendering the approved inputs itself; identities appear as entity refs (user:default/ann) rather than bare names. The second P2 attempt used successor acme/probe-valid because the probe names none. The adjudicator's probes left a succeeded run on gamma (main now 0d06059, successor acme/probe-approval) and a failed run on alpha in the plugin's database.
